description: Translate the end of the Elestou Zone and Commander Room story scene.

english:
The Legendary
Ancient
Weapons...?
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. Elestou Zone and other proper nouns follow the project glossary.

english:
That's enough
talk! Spadamon,
prepare
yourself!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. Elestou Zone and other proper nouns follow the project glossary.

english:
Hah! You're on!
Leave him to
me, Taiki!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. Elestou Zone and other proper nouns follow the project glossary.

english:
Now do you
understand the
power of Xros
Heart?
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. Elestou Zone and other proper nouns follow the project glossary.

english:
Guh... I didn't
expect Spadamon
to have allies
like this...
But before Lord
ZD
Millenniummon,
you're just
kids! Enjoy
your friendship
with that
weakling
Spadamon while
you can...!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. Elestou Zone and other proper nouns follow the project glossary.

english:
What a pain...
He lost to that
'weakling
Spadamon'?
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. Elestou Zone and other proper nouns follow the project glossary.

english:
Huh? Spadamon,
what's wrong?
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. Elestou Zone and other proper nouns follow the project glossary.

english:
W-what
happened? What
was that just
now?
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. Elestou Zone and other proper nouns follow the project glossary.

english:
Are you okay,
Spadamon?
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. Elestou Zone and other proper nouns follow the project glossary.

english:
I remember! The
Legendary
Ancient
Weapons...
That's the
secret sealed
in the Elestou
Zone! I must
never tell
anyone... I
think someone
told me that...
Who was it...?
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. Elestou Zone and other proper nouns follow the project glossary.

english:
...Hm? What's
wrong?
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. Elestou Zone and other proper nouns follow the project glossary.

english:
I can't
remember what
came after
that. But it's
a huge secret!
The Legendary
Ancient Weapons
are hidden in
this Zone. It
has to stay a
secret! ...Oh
no! I just told
everyone!
W-what do I
do?!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. Elestou Zone and other proper nouns follow the project glossary.

english:
It's okay,
Spadamon. We're
all your
friends. Still,
what a strange
guy. We were
fighting him
just a moment
ago... Wait!
Maybe
Spadamon's
memory came
back because he
fought...
because he got
stronger!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. Elestou Zone and other proper nouns follow the project glossary.

english:
...I got
stronger?
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. Elestou Zone and other proper nouns follow the project glossary.

english:
Wow! You really
beat him! He
looked so
scary. It must
have been hard
to take him
down!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. Elestou Zone and other proper nouns follow the project glossary.

english:
Heh... It
wasn't that
hard.
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. Elestou Zone and other proper nouns follow the project glossary.

english:
Zenjiro didn't
do anything,
though.
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. Elestou Zone and other proper nouns follow the project glossary.

english:
We got this
room back. Who
used it before?
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. Elestou Zone and other proper nouns follow the project glossary.

english:
This is the
Commander Room,
where the
commander
works. Taiki,
you can use it
if you'd like.
You're the
commander of
the Elestou
Zone now, after
all!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. Elestou Zone and other proper nouns follow the project glossary.

english:
You can also
accept requests
from the
monitor over
there.
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. Elestou Zone and other proper nouns follow the project glossary.

english:
If you use the
healing bed at
the back of the
room, you can
restore your
allies' HP and
MP.
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. Elestou Zone and other proper nouns follow the project glossary.

english:
Huh? Taiki
seems more
tired than the
Digimon. I can
explain
everything
later... Why
don't you rest
in the healing
bed for a
while?
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. Elestou Zone and other proper nouns follow the project glossary.

english:
That's right!
Taiki always
pushes himself
too hard. Go
rest in bed
first! We can
talk after.
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. Elestou Zone and other proper nouns follow the project glossary.

english:
I guess... Come
to think of it,
all of a
sudden... I
feel sleepy...
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. Elestou Zone and other proper nouns follow the project glossary.

english:
Good morning,
Taiki.
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. Elestou Zone and other proper nouns follow the project glossary.

english:
Huh? What's
with that
puzzled look?
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. Elestou Zone and other proper nouns follow the project glossary.

english:
...Hmm? Hey,
Akari... I feel
kind of dizzy.
Did I sleep too
long?
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. Elestou Zone and other proper nouns follow the project glossary.
